info.bio:
Raymond Scott (nacido Harry Warnow, 10 de septiembre de 1908 - fallecido el 8 de febrero de 1994),  fue un compositor, director de orquesta, pianista, ingeniero, e inventor de varios instrumentos electrónicos. 

Nació en Brooklyn en una familia de inmigrantes judíos de Rusia. Su hermano mayor, Marcos Warnow, un director de orquesta, violinista y director musical para el programa de radio de CBS "Your Hit Parade", alentó su carrera musical. 

Aunque Scott nunca obtuvo bandas sonoras de dibujos animados

podcast.title: Rhythm Synthesizer (1960)
podcast.body: An inventor interested in new electronic keyboards, Scott introduced a device called the rhythm synthesizer in 1960. "He also introduced something called the rhythm synthesizer in 1960."

podcast.title: Bandito the Bong Artist (c. 1963)
podcast.body: Following his rhythm synthesizer, Scott developed a drum machine named "Bandito the Bong Artist" around 1963. "That was followed by a drum machine he called Bandito the Bong Artist. This is from around 1963."

podcast.title: Cartoon Soundtrack Composer
podcast.body: Raymond Scott's compositions were extensively adapted for classic Looney Tunes and Merrie Melodies cartoons, providing the soundtracks for characters like Bugs Bunny and Porky Pig. "Hundreds of his works were adapted for old Looney tunes and Mary Melody's cartoons to soundtrack Bugs Bunny and Porkey Pig."
